description: 한국공항공사_공항 위치정보 [airports] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국공항공사. 한국공항공사(Korea Airports Cooperation)가 운영하는 전국 공항의 위치정보를 제공합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국공항공사. Its tags are 공항 주소, 행정구역, 지리, 공항 위치 위도, 공항 위치 경도. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-09-14 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
